research.title: What Is ISPM? How It Differs from IAM, PAM, IGA, and IDaaS
research.summary: Key Takeaways Identity Security Posture Management (ISPM) is the continuous risk and posture layer of the identity stack not a replacement for Identity and Access Management (IAM), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Identity Governance and Administration.
